- **Backpack:** I kept v32.81, which I picked over v32.79 under his rule 28. It has the same size and layout as v32.79 and cleaner tile borders. The panel is about 43 percent of the screen width at 1080p, which fits his "small to medium". It stays a live panel with no scrim and no x card. The latest critic score is 2, below the round's finish line of 3. The critic scored v32.79 and v32.81 at 3 on earlier runs and 2 on later ones, so its scores are unstable. Its P0 asks are empty slot outlines (vetoed as a bag-limit look) and a 70-90 percent card or scrim (his answer says no). His taste beats the critic, so I left them.
- **Trophy case:** untouched. It was done at v32.77 with a critic score of 3.

I added a line about this run to `tools/handoff/console/notes/45-ui-backpack-trophy.md`.
